entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Sanjeev Kumar Paswan Son Of Raja Ram Paswan Resident
Of Village- Panr, Police Station- Dalsinghsarai, District-
For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Zainul Abedin

======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 4 16-04-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
2.
The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable u/s 406 and 420 of the IPC.

3. As per the prosecution case, Rs.13,50000/- was credited in the account of Ward Implementation Management Committee, Ward No.12, Gram Panchayat Raj Paur through cheques for completion of a work but the work was not executed as per the standard norms and defalcation of money was done.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is quite innocent and has committed no offence.
He has been falsely implicated in this case due to ulterior motive.

It Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.1884 of 2024(4) dt.16-04-2024 is submitted that petitioner was the Ward Secretary of Ward no.12 and he executed the said work, which is clear from the Measurement book and for the said work Rs.11,47080/- was invested and by filing a supplementary affidavit, it has been stated that the petitioner has deposited the rest amount of Rs.2,02,920/- which has been alleged to be defalcated by him.

sentences.text: Learned APP for the State opposed the prayer for bail.

6. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and considering the statement made in the supplementary affidavit regarding deposit of the defalcated amount, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court below where the case is pending/Successor Court in connection with Dalsinghsarai P.S. Case No.373 of 2022, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) pallavi/-
